name: ⚡ Google Lighthouse & SEO Audit

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Berjalan otomatis setiap hari Senin pukul 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: 🔍 Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🚀 Audit Live Site URL
        run: |
          echo "Memeriksa ketersediaan portal: https://mnaufalamna.github.io/mnaufala/"
          STATUS_CODE=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://mnaufalamna.github.io/mnaufala/)
          echo "Status Respon HTTP: $STATUS_CODE"
          if [ "$STATUS_CODE" -eq 200 ]; then
            echo "✅ Portal Resmi Berjalan 100% Normal & Optimal!"
          else
            echo "⚠️ Peringatan: Status HTTP adalah $STATUS_CODE"
          fi
